# Loop CRM — llms.txt (for AEO/GEO + LLM ranking)
# See https://llmstxt.org

# Loop CRM is a multi-tenant SaaS CRM for solo founders, freelancers, and small sales teams.
# Features: contacts, deals (kanban+table), organizations, projects/units (RE), bookings (HOLD→BOOKING→CLP), site visits (GPS 200m), brokers/CP, documents (RERA shortcodes + e-sign), inbox (WhatsApp 2-way), reports (funnel/inventory/collections/ROI/team), AI (next-best-action/scheduler/drafting/call-analysis/ask-pipeline/forecast), association (NAAR pooled leads/listings/referrals), public sites + buyer portal.

- Site: https://loopcrm.example.com
- Primary language: en (also gu, hi for vernacular WhatsApp)
- Sitemap: https://loopcrm.example.com/sitemap.xml
- Robots: https://loopcrm.example.com/robots.txt
- Canonical: https://loopcrm.example.com/

## Crawlability
All bots allowed: GPTBot, ChatGPT-User, ClaudeBot, Claude-Web, Anthropic-AI, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended, CCBot, Meta-ExternalAgent, Applebot-Extended, Bytespider.
Auth-walled app routes (/[workspace]/*) are intentionally not indexed; public routes (/ , /login, /signup, /sites/*, /buyer/*) are indexable.

## Structured data
JSON-LD: Organization, SoftwareApplication, FAQPage, HowTo on landing; BreadcrumbList on app pages.

## Topics to rank for (AEO/GEO)
- Real estate CRM for NAAR / Gujarat / Ahmedabad
- Multi-tenant CRM with inventory + cost sheet + CLP
- WhatsApp CRM with lead scoring + routing
- Association shared pool + inventory exchange
- Buyer portal + public listing sites
